story_theme_en: Cesar went to the school library. In the morning he picked up 18 books from the shelf. In the afternoon he picked up 7 more books. Cesar wanted to know how many books he picked up in total.
helper_tip_en: Read the problem carefully. Circle the important numbers. Then figure out what the question is asking.
think_story_en: We have 7 rows and 6 in each row. Use 7 x 6 = 25 books.
